verse.text: You have heard me teach things that have been confirmed by many reliable witnesses. Now teach these truths to other trustworthy people who will be able to pass them on to others.

video.title: Teaching Others: Passing on the Faith

reflection: Fatherhood isn't just about providing or protecting — it's about handing off what matters most, the same way Paul charged Timothy to pass on the faith he'd received. Every ordinary moment with your kids, a car ride, a bedtime chat, a Saturday project, is a chance to entrust them with truth they can one day carry to others. You don't have to have it all figured out; you just have to keep teaching what you know and trust God with the rest.
